failure_rule: Do not narrate the structural fact as established canon. Resolve, reconstruct, or generate the blueprint first under the proper authority class.
generated_filler_rule: Original filler spaces are allowed only when source facts do not determine the space and the generated record is explicitly labeled ORIGINAL_FILLER / GAMEPLAY_RECONSTRUCTION rather than source canon.
pass_rule: Every required field is populated, internally consistent, and validation_state is READY. created_before_narration must be true.
